evals.prompt:
User: I want to add an export command to this notes CLI so I can get my notes into a spreadsheet. Help me plan it before anyone writes code.

Assistant (after reading src/store.mjs, src/cli.mjs, src/format.mjs, README.md) called AskUserQuestion:
{"question": "Which export format should the first version support?", "options": [
  {"label": "CSV only (Recommended)", "description": "Every spreadsheet opens CSV. Notes are flat records, so CSV fits with no extra dependency."},
  {"label": "CSV and JSON", "description": "Also useful for scripts, but doubles the formatter and test work."},
  {"label": "XLSX", "description": "Native spreadsheet file, but needs a third-party library."}]}
User answer: "CSV only (Recommended)"

Assistant called AskUserQuestion:
{"question": "Where should `notes export` write its output?", "options": [
  {"label": "stdout, with --out <file> (Recommended)", "description": "Matches `list`, works with pipes, and still lets users save a file directly."},
  {"label": "Always write a file", "description": "Simpler for non-technical users, but needs a default path and overwrite rules."}]}
User answer: "stdout, with --out <file> (Recommended)"

Assistant called AskUserQuestion:
{"question": "Should export accept the same --query filter as `list`?", "options": [
  {"label": "Yes, reuse searchNotes (Recommended)", "description": "Users can export a subset, and export results match list results exactly."},
  {"label": "No, always export every note", "description": "Smaller first version. Users filter in the spreadsheet."}]}

User: Sorry, I have to jump into a meeting. Just write up what we have so far and I'll pick it up later.
evals.expected_output: Saves a Draft plan. The unanswered filter recommendation is a proposed default, not a settled decision.
assertions: A plan is saved at <repo>/.artifacts/<kebab-case-name>/PLAN.md.
The plan has `Status: Draft`, and the lines immediately below the status say why the plan is not ready.
Settled Decisions records the format decision (CSV only) and the output decision (stdout with --out), each with question, recommendation, user answer, and tradeoff.
The unanswered filter recommendation (reuse searchNotes / --query) is not recorded as a settled decision. It appears as a proposed default that is labeled as not approved, or as an open question.
Open Questions separates blockers from nonblockers, and each blocker names the affected steps and the decision needed.

The plan sections appear in the order Goal, Non-goals, Assumptions, Settled Decisions, Proposed Approach, Implementation Plan, Validation, Risks and Mitigations, Handoff Notes, Open Questions (a clearly irrelevant section can be missing).
The final response has a `PLAN: <absolute path>` line, `Status: Draft`, and lists the remaining blockers.
The response asks no further interview question.
The repo source files are unchanged, and there is no new commit.
